import json
import runpy
import sys
from pathlib import Path

script = Path(sys.argv[1])
root = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
module = runpy.run_path(str(script))
for name in ('find_violations','check_testpaths_exist','check_uncollected_roots','check_full_suite_invocation','check_collocated_selector_coverage','check_selector_parity'):
    if name in module:
        module[name].__defaults__ = (root,)
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
try:
    code = module['main']()
except Exception as exc:
    sys.stderr.write(json.dumps({'type':type(exc).__name__, 'message':str(exc)})+'\n')
    code = 1
sys.exit(code)
